title: Battle of Malacca (1534)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Malacca (1534)", at revision 1370448660, opens: "The Battle of Malacca took place in 1534 between Johor and the Portuguese navy. The battle ended in favor of the Johorese, as they defeated the Portuguese near Malacca, but a strong wind saved the Portuguese from destruction." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q127868126, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1534 naval battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
